_doc: Reviewed transcription of the Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Plan 2023's coastal high-vulnerability list: fourteen districts named as highly vulnerable to the monsoon systems of the Bay of Bengal. The plan states statewide annual flooding separately, so this list understates inland flood exposure by construction; the served page says so. The TNSDMA host completes only plain-http requests (the TLS handshake fails), which the registry entry records.

source.title: Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Plan 2023
source.publisher: Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority, Government of Tamil Nadu

classification.statement: Fourteen coastal districts named highly vulnerable; inland flood exposure is stated separately and is not classified per district.
classification.quote: The 14 coastal Districts, viz., Chennai, Kancheepuram, Tiruvallur, Cuddalore, Villupuram, Thanjavur, Tiruvarur, Nagapattinam, Myladuthirai, Pudukottai, Ramanathapuram, Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli and Kanniyakumari are highly vulnerable and affected frequently by the trough and depression formed in the Bay of Bengal and Indian Ocean during South-West and North-East monsoon periods.

review.transcribedBy: read from the plan's PDF text by the maintainer's assistant
